preamble:
This Non-Disclosure Agreement (this "Agreement") is entered into as of {effectiveDate} (the "Effective Date") by and between:

DISCLOSING PARTY:
{partyAName}, with its principal place of business at {partyAAddress} (the "Disclosing Party")

RECEIVING PARTY:
{partyBName}, with its principal place of business at {partyBAddress} (the "Receiving Party")
background: WHEREAS the Disclosing Party possesses certain confidential and proprietary information; and WHEREAS the Receiving Party desires to receive such information for the purpose of evaluating or pursuing a business relationship between the parties (the "Purpose"); NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual promises and covenants contained herein, and for other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby acknowledged, the parties agree as follows:

definitions.definition: means the party identified above as the Disclosing Party, including its officers, directors, employees, agents, and authorized representatives.
means the party identified above as the Receiving Party, including its officers, directors, employees, agents, and authorized representatives.
means the evaluation or pursuit of a potential business relationship between the parties, and any discussions, negotiations, or transactions related thereto.

means a party's affiliates, and its and their respective officers, directors, employees, agents, advisors (including legal counsel, accountants, and financial advisors), and other authorized representatives.
means all documents, records, data, samples, prototypes, software, models, and other materials (in whatever form) that contain or embody Confidential Information.

standardClauses.title: Excluded information
Mutual confidentiality obligations
No license or transfer of rights
standardClauses.text: Nothing in this Agreement grants the Receiving Party any right, title, or interest in or to the Confidential Information, or any license under any intellectual property rights of the Disclosing Party. All Confidential Information remains the sole and exclusive property of the Disclosing Party.

standardClauses.title: No warranty on information
standardClauses.text: ALL CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION IS PROVIDED "AS IS." THE DISCLOSING PARTY MAKES NO WARRANTIES, EXPRESS OR IMPLIED, REGARDING THE ACCURACY, COMPLETENESS, OR FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE OF ANY CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION. The Disclosing Party shall have no liability for any errors or omissions in the Confidential Information, or for any decisions made by the Receiving Party in reliance upon it.

standardClauses.title: Compelled disclosure

generalProvisions.title: Entire agreement
generalProvisions.text: This Agreement constitutes the entire agreement between the parties with respect to the subject matter hereof and supersedes all prior negotiations, representations, warranties, commitments, offers, and agreements, whether written or oral.

generalProvisions.title: Amendments
generalProvisions.text: This Agreement may not be amended, modified, or supplemented except by a written instrument signed by both parties.

generalProvisions.title: Severability
generalProvisions.text: If any provision of this Agreement is held to be invalid, illegal, or unenforceable, the remaining provisions shall continue in full force and effect, and the invalid provision shall be modified to the minimum extent necessary to make it valid and enforceable.

generalProvisions.title: Waiver
generalProvisions.text: No failure or delay by either party in exercising any right under this Agreement shall operate as a waiver thereof, nor shall any single or partial exercise of any right preclude any further exercise of that or any other right.

generalProvisions.title: Notices
generalProvisions.text: All notices under this Agreement shall be in writing and shall be deemed given: (a) when delivered personally; (b) when sent by confirmed electronic mail; (c) one (1) business day after being sent by internationally recognized overnight courier; or (d) three (3) business days after being mailed by registered or certified mail, postage prepaid, to the parties at their respective addresses set forth above.

generalProvisions.title: Counterparts
generalProvisions.text: This Agreement may be executed in counterparts, each of which shall be deemed an original, and all of which together shall constitute one and the same instrument. Electronic signatures shall be deemed original signatures for all purposes.

CALIFORNIA.title: California-specific provisions
CALIFORNIA.text:
(a) Trade Secrets: To the extent Confidential Information constitutes trade secrets under the California Uniform Trade Secrets Act (Cal. Civ. Code §3426 et seq.) ("CUTSA"), the protections of CUTSA shall apply in addition to the protections of this Agreement.

(b) Injunctive Relief: Each party acknowledges that a breach of this Agreement may cause irreparable harm for which monetary damages would be an inadequate remedy. Accordingly, the Disclosing Party shall be entitled to seek injunctive or other equitable relief without the requirement of posting a bond, in addition to all other remedies available at law or in equity.

(c) Jury Waiver: EACH PARTY HEREBY IRREVOCABLY WAIVES, TO THE FULLEST EXTENT PERMITTED BY APPLICABLE LAW, ALL RIGHTS TO TRIAL BY JURY IN ANY ACTION, PROCEEDING, OR COUNTERCLAIM ARISING OUT OF OR RELATING TO THIS AGREEMENT.

(d) CCPA/CPRA: To the extent that any Confidential Information includes personal information as defined under the California Consumer Privacy Act (Cal. Civ. Code §1798.100 et seq.) and the California Privacy Rights Act, the Receiving Party shall comply with all applicable requirements thereunder.

ENGLAND_WALES.title: England & Wales-specific provisions
ENGLAND_WALES.text:
(a) Third Party Rights: No person who is not a party to this Agreement shall have any rights under the Contracts (Rights of Third Parties) Act 1999 to enforce any term of this Agreement.

(b) Non-Excludable Liability: Nothing in this Agreement shall exclude or limit liability for: (i) fraud or fraudulent misrepresentation; (ii) death or personal injury caused by negligence; or (iii) any other liability that cannot be excluded or limited under applicable law.

(c) Equitable Relief: Each party acknowledges that damages alone may not be an adequate remedy for breach of this Agreement, and that the Disclosing Party shall be entitled to seek the remedies of injunction, specific performance, and other equitable relief for any threatened or actual breach.

(d) UK GDPR: To the extent that any Confidential Information includes personal data as defined under the UK General Data Protection Regulation and the Data Protection Act 2018, the Receiving Party shall comply with all applicable requirements thereunder.

SPAIN.title: Spain-specific provisions (Disposiciones específicas para España)
SPAIN.text:
(a) Ley de Secretos Empresariales: To the extent Confidential Information constitutes trade secrets (secretos empresariales) under Ley 1/2019, de 20 de febrero, de Secretos Empresariales, the protections of that law shall apply in addition to the protections of this Agreement.

(b) Good Faith: This Agreement shall be interpreted and performed in accordance with the principle of good faith (buena fe) as set forth in Articles 7 and 1258 of the Código Civil.

(c) Interpretation: In the event of any ambiguity, this Agreement shall be interpreted in accordance with the rules of interpretation set forth in Articles 1281 through 1289 of the Código Civil.

(d) GDPR/LOPDGDD: To the extent that any Confidential Information includes personal data as defined under the EU General Data Protection Regulation (Regulation (EU) 2016/679) and the Ley Orgánica 3/2018 de Protección de Datos Personales y garantía de los derechos digitales (LOPDGDD), the Receiving Party shall comply with all applicable requirements thereunder.
